author: profbananaslug
body:
so today a dear friend of mine got tempbanned from teamspeak for "not having the right username", so i'd thought it would be hilarious (it was) to join the server with what they said was his real usernameand after sitting around not doing much for a bit i got perm-banned for "ban evasion" (which was also hilarious tbh). but for real, not ban evading, just like check the ips and stuff.

anyways if you need additional proof i'm me feel free to ask (no weird philosophical questions though)
